description_en: Adds stream pulling configurations, including the addresses of the origin server, start time, and end time
description_zh: 添加拉流配置信息，包括源站地址、开始时间和结束时间
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-pull-stream-info-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name 'liveApp****' --stream-name 'liveStream****' --source-url 'rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp****/liveStream****;rtmp://developer.aliyundoc.com/liveApp****/liveStream****' --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLivePullStreamInfoConfig

parameters.help_en: Your streaming domain name is the ingest domain of the streamer
parameters.help_zh: 您的拉流域名为用户的主播流域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. This parameter is user-defined
parameters.help_zh: 直播流所属应用名称，用户自定义
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream. This parameter is user-defined
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The complete origin URL of the user's live stream. You can specify multiple origin URLs separated by semicolons (;).
Only live streams are supported. The supported formats are RTMP, FLV, HLS, and SRT
parameters.help_zh:
用户的直播流所在的源站完整url。多个源站可以填多个地址，用英文分号（;）分隔。
仅支持拉取直播流，支持RTMP、FLV、HLS、SRT格式
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.help_en: The start time of stream pulling. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 7 days. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 拉流开始时间。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of stream pulling. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 7 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 拉流结束时间。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内，且EndTime超过当前时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time
